apps.localizedDescription:
RustRadar:

A live flight radar on a 3D globe: Tauri 2 + SvelteKit (Svelte 5) + deck.gl 9, backed by a native Rust port of the fr24 Python library.

• Every live aircraft (~20k worldwide), drawn from the real shape of its type. Around 99.7% of live traffic resolves to one of 40 aircraft models; the rest (fighters, drones, balloons, ground vehicles) keep the built-in low-poly shapes. What you see depends on the camera:.

• Flat and wide — a top-down silhouette of the actual type, which is how a map read from straight above wants to look.
• Tilted — the real mesh, about 220 triangles, enough for the planform, engines and fin.
• Zoom 11 and closer — the same mesh at about 2,600 triangles, tilted or not.
